criteria.description: Acceptance requires fixed-cut and detached-output behavior, cancellation and lease disposal, fork/inherited-prefix preservation, late-live and persistence conflict behavior, SQLite shadowing/retry/fingerprint behavior, retained fallback semantics, focused tests, type/lint, dependency, documentation, whitespace, and complete-candidate metric evidence.

conditions: Do not make session-query or persistence mandatory in sdk-minimal as part of A09.
Do not change Session format generations, raw event sequence values, wire versions, or persistence schema.
Dispose each live observation before returning from a Corpus projection or SQLite reconciliation step; no caller may retain the borrowed event array.
Run the canonical metrics command only on a complete successor candidate before claiming a ratchet PASS.
Keep REM-028-S067-069 with the session-projection owner and do not introduce a query-to-projection dependency cycle.
